02 The systemic problem

Identity databases become breach inventories.

Conventional verification transfers the most sensitive input to the least controllable part of the system. Qyvox changes the question from “What is your data?” to “Can this claim be proven?”

03 How it works

Private computation.
Public confidence.

Three deliberately bounded systems replace one over-privileged identity pipeline.

01

PRIVATE INPUT

Client-side witness

The user enters a birth year into device memory. It is never serialized into an application request.

Memory boundary / browser
02

74 R1CS CONSTRAINTS

WASM ZK prover

Circom constraints execute through SnarkJS and WebAssembly. The witness is cleared immediately after fullProve().

Groth16 / BN254
03

PUBLIC VERDICT

Proof-only attestation

FastAPI verifies a compact cryptographic statement and persists a UUID, timestamp, and replay fingerprint—never DOB.
